description: Create an on-demand payout for a community owner. Requires confirm set to CREATE_PAYOUT. Business and community refer to the same thing and are interchangeable. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation for this write. Pass the exact literal this tool requires (for example DELETE) only after the user approves the action.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD.

latestTransactionId.description: Most recent transaction ID included in the payout, from the payout balance tools.

name: create_community_payout_on_demand
title: Create Business Payout On Demand
